question: Who is the only Indian athlete to be included in TIME magazine's list of the 100 Most Influential People in Sports for 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Smriti Mandhana**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**
__
• Indian cricket vice-captain **Smriti Mandhana** has been featured in **TIME magazine's** list of the **100 Most Influential People in Sports for 2026**.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**
__
• **Smriti Mandhana** is the **only Indian** athlete to feature in the annual selection for 2026.
• The list is led by basketball legend **LeBron James** and includes other global stars like **Lionel Messi**, **Cristiano Ronaldo**, and **Carlos Alcaraz**.
• TIME recognized Mandhana for her role in pushing the boundaries of women's cricket, noting she was the **first Indian woman** to score a **double century** in a domestic one-day game and the first to register **centuries across all three international formats**.
• She is tied for the most centuries in women's international cricket with **17 centuries** and became the first player to score more than **1,000 ODI runs** in a calendar year.
• Her leadership was also highlighted, specifically guiding **Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB)** to **Women's Premier League (WPL)** titles in **2024 and 2026**.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
__
• Mandhana was a key contributor to **India's ICC Women's World Cup** victory in **2025**.
• She received the **BBC Indian Sportswoman award** following her record-breaking performance in 2025, where she surpassed her own record for the **most international runs** scored by a woman in a calendar year.
• The TIME list describes its members as **changemakers** shaping the global sporting landscape.
** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

• At **29 years old**, Mandhana has achieved 17 international centuries, tying the record for the most in women's international cricket.
• She led her franchise, **Royal Challengers Bengaluru**, to two titles within three years of the tournament's inception.</ul
